$comment: Tumult's anonymous play data: every event the web version sends to its Froglet Analytics server, and every field. The server accepts only the events named here (it reads this file from the repository's bleeding-edge branch each night). The game names the events in src/ui/telemetry.js; src/web/analytics.js adds the envelope and sends them. Change this file together with telemetry.js, and bump schema_version (also in telemetry.js) when a field's meaning changes. docs/reference/ANALYTICS.md is the prose.
privacy: Anonymous: a random id made on the player's device, no account, no names a player typed, no save, no IP address stored (the server keeps only a two-letter country). A player turns it off on the title screen; a browser with Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track sends nothing.

distinct_id.description: The anonymous player id: 't_' and 24 hex digits, made at random on the device's first visit and kept in localStorage (tumult_v2_anon).

os.description: iOS | Android | ChromeOS | Windows | macOS | Linux | other, from the browser.

form_factor.description: desktop | tablet | phone (touch screen and its short side).

schema_version.description: This file's schema_version when the event was made.

timestamp_utc_ms.description: The device's clock when the event was made, Unix epoch milliseconds.

session_started.description: The game's page opened (a visit). The first step of the new-player funnel.

first_visit.description: No anonymous id existed on this device before this visit.

visit.description: Visits on this device, this one included.

days_since_first.description: Whole days since this device's first visit.

runs_before.description: Expeditions started on this device before this visit.

missions_before.description: Missions finished on this device before this visit.

has_save.description: A run in progress was saved (the title offers Continue).

referrer.description: direct | self | other | the froglet.games / froglet.studio host the visit came from. Never a full address.

session_ended.description: The page was closed or left (pagehide).

screen.description: The screen it was closed on (title, draft, map, mission, reward, ...).

mission_round.description: The round of a mission left unfinished on the mission screen; null otherwise.

tutorial_shown.description: A first-time tip was shown (once per device per tip).

guide_step.description: The guided first mission (src/ui/welcome.js): the player moved through its five steps, finished it or skipped it.

step.description: The step the player was on, 1 to 5.

key.description: That step: dice | cards | intent | forecast | end.

signin_prompt.description: Keep your squad: the offer to sign in under the first won mission's report (src/ui/welcome.js), and what came of it. Only where accounts are available.

where.description: first_win (the only place it is offered today).

action.description: shown | opened (the sign-in box) | later (Not now) | signed_in.

invite_link.description: An invite to an online game: a link opened, joined or declined, or a host copying theirs.

can_join.description: This page could reach online play when it happened.

run_started.description: An expedition begins: New Expedition (the draft) or, on a first visit, Play now (two pre-made pilots, straight to the map).

first_run.description: The first expedition started on this device.

runs_before.description: Expeditions started on this device before this one.

play_now.description: Started with Play now (src/ui/welcome.js), not the draft.

draft_completed.description: The squad is drafted and the Tide Map opens.

squad.description: The squad, one entry per pilot: {pilot: a pre-made pilot's id (game content) or 'made' for one a player built, clades: [two clade ids], cards: how many cards in the kit}. A made pilot's name is never sent.

mission_started.description: A mission's board opened for the first time (a mission resumed from a save is not counted again).

match_id.description: The mission: '<run seed>:<missions the run had launched>'. Groups a mission's start, end or leaving.

mission_number.description: Which mission of the run this is, from 1.

tide.description: The run's difficulty (a key of T.TIDES); null for a quick mission.

quick.description: A mission started on its own, not on an expedition.

squad.description: The squad, one entry per pilot: {pilot: a pre-made pilot's id (game content) or 'made' for one a player built, clades: [two clade ids], cards: how many cards in the kit}. A made pilot's name is never sent.

first_mission.description: No mission had been finished on this device before.

mission_ended.description: A mission reached its end, won or lost. The playtest report's fields, sent.

match_id.description: The mission: '<run seed>:<missions the run had launched>'. Groups a mission's start, end or leaving.

mission_number.description: Which mission of the run this is, from 1.

tide.description: The run's difficulty (a key of T.TIDES); null for a quick mission.

quick.description: A mission started on its own, not on an expedition.

squad.description: The squad, one entry per pilot: {pilot: a pre-made pilot's id (game content) or 'made' for one a player built, clades: [two clade ids], cards: how many cards in the kit}. A made pilot's name is never sent.

seconds.description: Seconds from the mission's start to its end on this device (a resumed mission counts from its first start).

hp.description: Each pilot's hit points at the end, in squad order.

max_hp.description: Each pilot's maximum hit points, in squad order.

faces_ethereal_at_e0.description: Ethereal faces played on a card at E 0 (only when ETHEREAL_MIN_E allows it).

faces.description: Plays per face: {'<card id>:<P|E>': count}. Card ids are in docs/reference/CARDS.md. A take-back removes the play it undid.

first_mission.description: The first mission finished on this device.

mission_left.description: The player went back to the title with the mission unfinished (it stays saved).

match_id.description: The mission: '<run seed>:<missions the run had launched>'. Groups a mission's start, end or leaving.

mission_number.description: Which mission of the run this is, from 1.

tide.description: The run's difficulty (a key of T.TIDES); null for a quick mission.

quick.description: A mission started on its own, not on an expedition.

squad.description: The squad, one entry per pilot: {pilot: a pre-made pilot's id (game content) or 'made' for one a player built, clades: [two clade ids], cards: how many cards in the kit}. A made pilot's name is never sent.

round.description: The round it was left in.

run_ended.description: An expedition ended: the Heart won, or the squad lost.

squad.description: The squad, one entry per pilot: {pilot: a pre-made pilot's id (game content) or 'made' for one a player built, clades: [two clade ids], cards: how many cards in the kit}. A made pilot's name is never sent.

pilot_saved.description: A player kept a pilot they built (the character workshop). Never its name.

analytics_turned_off.description: The player turned play data off on the title screen (the last event this device sends).

analytics_turned_on.description: The player turned play data back on.

client_exception.description: A script error on the page (at most five a visit).

message.description: The error's message, at most 200 characters.
